assumptions.statement: Site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry with official_boundary=false and boundary_precision=provisional_rough.
assumptions.impact: All derived areas, ratios, partitions and map extents remain low-confidence and must be recalculated after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-003 is preserved exactly and currently lies near Beijing North Railway Station; it cannot establish the Dazhongsi site.
assumptions.impact: The Dazhongsi proposal is limited to a four-direction potential access framework without confirmed entrances or footprint.

assumptions.statement: Statutory plan, parcel rights, development intensity, building heights, road redlines and approval conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land use, massing, access and implementation are conceptual design recommendations.

assumptions.statement: Station entrances, passenger flows, rail crossing rights, bridge clearance, traffic engineering and parking inventory are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Five transverse connections and all station links require field survey, operator consultation and engineering review.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints come from the 2026-08-12 OSM/BBBike extract; height, floor count, use, ownership, fire safety and structure are not verified.
assumptions.impact: Selected footprints identify adaptive-reuse and shared-ground-floor opportunities only; they do not authorize demolition or occupation.

assumptions.statement: Underground utilities, drainage capacity, power, data, district energy and maintenance responsibilities are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Technical-facility and climate-infrastructure proposals require utility survey and professional design.

assumptions.statement: River control lines, flood levels, ecological protection conditions and outfall permissions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green actions are conceptual and require water-affairs, ecological and drainage verification.

assumptions.statement: Geometry metrics use EPSG:4548 and the submitted provisional/design layers.
assumptions.impact: Values support internal consistency checks and comparative design review; they are not statutory or construction quantities.

assumptions.statement: QGIS analysis uses OSM background data, provisional boundaries, modelled grids and Mapbox visual reference rather than official survey datasets.
assumptions.impact: Accessibility, activity and opportunity metrics are screening evidence and require field verification.

assumptions.statement: Mapbox Basic Overcast is used as a visual basemap; OSM-derived vector data are background-only.
assumptions.impact: Basemap appearance and OSM completeness do not establish legal boundaries, entrances, ownership or approved conditions.
